title: AceFF: A State-of-the-Art Machine Learning Potential for Small Molecules
abstract: arXiv:2601.00581v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce AceFF, a pre-trained machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) optimized for small molecule drug discovery. While MLIPs have emerged as efficient alternatives to Density Functional Theory (DFT), generalizability across diverse chemical spaces remains difficult. AceFF addresses this by refining the TensorNet2 architecture and training it on a comprehensive dataset of drug-like compounds. This approach yields a force field that balances high-throughput inference speed with DFT-level accuracy. We introduce two models sharing the same architecture: \mbox{AceFF-2}, trained on our own dataset of small molecules and supporting the essential medicinal chemistry elements (H, B, C, N, O, F, Si, P, S, Cl, Br, I); and \mbox{AceFF-2-OMOL}, trained on a subset of OMol25 containing the AceFF-2 elements plus the common biomolecular ion elements Na and K. translated_title: AceFF：面向小分子的最先进机器学习原子间势
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了AceFF，一个为小分子药物发现优化的预训练机器学习原子间势（MLIP）。尽管MLIP已成为密度泛函理论（DFT）的高效替代方案，但其在多样化化学空间中的泛化能力仍是一大难题。AceFF通过改进TensorNet2架构并在一个涵盖类药物化合物的综合数据集上进行训练来解决这一问题。这种方法使该力场在高通量推理速度与DFT级精度之间取得了平衡。我们推出了两个共享相同架构的模型：AceFF-2，在我们自己的小分子数据集上训练，支持药物化学的基本元素（H、B、C、N、O、F、Si、P、S、Cl、Br、I）；以及AceFF-2-OMOL，在OMol25的一个子集上训练，包含AceFF-2的元素以及常见的生物分子离子元素Na和K。这些模型经过专门训练以处理带电状态。验证……
tldr: AceFF是一个为小分子药物发现优化的预训练机器学习原子间势，通过改进TensorNet2架构并在类药物化合物综合数据集上训练，实现了高通量推理速度与DFT级精度的平衡，并支持带电状态和多种药物化学关键元素。
en_tdlr: AceFF is a pre-trained machine learning interatomic potential for small molecule drug discovery that achieves both high-throughput inference speed and DFT-level accuracy by refining the TensorNet2 architecture and training on a comprehensive dataset of drug-like compounds, while explicitly supporting charged states and essential medicinal chemistry elements.
